topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't help but think about the email I received, the one that told me my invention was already patented. I wonder how I missed it, all the research and brainstorming, and yet, someone beat me to it. I should have been more thorough, more cautious. It’s a reminder of the relentless pace of innovation, and how many minds are striving for the same breakthroughs. I hope the person who patented it does well, even as I question if I could have done more. It's a learning moment, a stark one, and I'm already planning my next steps, more diligent this time.
